issues.issue: Race condition: Accessing config map immediately after getting the instance, while loadConfig goroutine has not yet completed.
Nil map access: Accessing config["apiUrl"] before loadConfig completes initialization of the map, which may result in nil pointer dereference.
Premature execution: Launches fetchData goroutine within NewUserProfile constructor, which might not complete before other methods are called.
Nil map access: Accessing profile.data immediately after instantiation results in nil map access, since fetchData goroutine hasn't completed.
Race condition: Calls ReadFile without ensuring the WriteFile goroutine has completed.
File access error: ReadFile might access file before WriteFile goroutine has finished writing, leading to errors or incomplete data.
